drivers.variant_notes: Breakshot 1.3, the catalog's root driver: INITGAMEFF(bsv103, 5, ..., 0xa7da) in src/wpc/capgames.c, so it publishes the ROM's game-on (Fast Flips) flag as solenoid 51. The retained known-working table runs it (cGameName "bsv103") and every harness run behind this record booted it.

Breakshot 1.2: plain INITGAME(bsv102, 5, ...) with the same gameno, so the same capInvSw5/capFlip5 switch and flipper definitions and the same three sound ROMs; plain INITGAME publishes no solenoid 51.

Breakshot Beta 1.5: plain INITGAME(bsb105, 8, ...); capInvSw8 and capFlip8 equal the gameno-5 values, so the address topology is bsv103's without solenoid 51. Its sound set loads bsu28_b1.2 in place of u28_v11.bin.

Breakshot Redemption 1.0 (source comment 'Redemption Version 1.0I'): plain INITGAME(bsv100r, 6, ...) with capInvSw6/capFlip6 equal to the gameno-5 values and a fourth sound ROM, u30_v10i.bin. Redemption firmware for this machine: the manual's Redemption menu (PDF 55), which it says is not in every software version, sets the game up for an optional ticket or token dispenser, driven from the CPU's J3 interface board (PB-6 wiring, PDF 145) on lines PinMAME does not publish. No ROM image of it was run here. No solenoid 51.

Breakshot Redemption 1.2 (source comment 'Redemption Version 1.2I'): plain INITGAME(bsv102r, 7, ...) with capInvSw7/capFlip7 equal to the gameno-5 values and the fourth sound ROM u30_v10i.bin. Redemption firmware for this machine with the manual's optional ticket or token dispenser, like bsv100r; not run here. No solenoid 51.

mechanisms.behavior: A drained ball rolls into the outhole under the apron's centre (switch 35, SW00113). The outhole coil (S1) kicks it into a three-ball trough that runs up towards the shooter lane under the apron, sensed by the three trough optos 38, 37 and 36, position 1 (36) at the shooter end. The trough coil (S2) serves the ball at position 1 into the shooter lane (switch 43), where the player plunges it. The retained script creates the three balls in sw38, sw37 and sw36 with all three optos set, kicks sw35 on S1 and sw36 on S2, and rolls the remaining balls forward (sw37 to sw36, sw38 to sw37) when a position empties. In the harness, Start with a credit and a full trough fired S2 together with both drop-bank resets, pulsing S2 five times while position 1 (36) stayed closed, and released S2 when the ball left position 1.
mechanisms.label: Outhole and Ball Trough

mechanisms.behavior: A kicker in the left outlane (S6 KICKER) returns a ball rolling down the outlane past switch 46 to the playfield; the ROM fires it when the kickback is lit (lamp 28 KICKER, at the left outlane). The retained script holds its plunger PlungerKB pulled back and fires it while S6 is energized.
mechanisms.label: Left Outlane Kickback

mechanisms.behavior: Three drop targets in a diagonal row on the upper right (switches 49 left, 50 centre, 51 right, SW00106) with a standup target behind them (52, SW00141) that a ball reaches once the drops are down. One reset coil (S7) raises all three. In the harness, dropping 49, 50 and 51 took the score from 0 to 9,000; the ROM fired S7 with the trough eject when Start began the game, but not while the dropped bank stayed down for 4 s, and the run served no further ball. The retained script numbers the bank 48-50 with the standup 51 (a table defect: the ROM never reacts to 48), and its ResetDropsRight raises its three drops on S7.
mechanisms.label: Right Drop Target Bank

mechanisms.behavior: Three drop targets in a diagonal row on the left side (switches 73 lowest, 74, 75 highest, SW00106) with a standup target behind them (76, SW00141). One reset coil (S13) raises all three (the script's ResetDropsLeft: DTRaise 73, 74, 75). In the harness, dropping 73 and 74 each played the ROM's drop-target animation and, with 75 down too, the display returned to the score; the ROM fired S13 with the trough eject when Start began the game, but not while the dropped bank stayed down for 4 s, and the run served no further ball.
mechanisms.label: Left Drop Target Bank

mechanisms.behavior: A saucer on the right side below the upper right flipper holds the ball on switch 67 (SW00118) until S8 (BONUS SAUCER) kicks it out. The retained script kicks only a ball that is sitting in sw67 and clears 67 when the ball leaves.
mechanisms.label: Bonus Saucer

mechanisms.behavior: A post at the foot of the centre pocket assembly, between the Lite Super Cue targets 77 and 78, raised by S12 (CENTER POST UP) and released by S14 (CENTER POST DOWN); switch 66 (SW00118) closes while it is up. The retained script raises its walls CenterPostWall001-003 on S12 and sets 66 at the end of the rise, and on S14 drops them and clears 66 at the end of the fall (its comment: S14 also pulses while the post fires up). IPDB describes a large metal plug in front of the centre feature that rises after a captured ball and that the player hits.
mechanisms.label: Center Post

mechanisms.behavior: Three pockets side by side behind the centre post, each with its own switch (68 left, 69 centre, 70 right, SW00139) and its own eject coil (S25, S26, S32), with the centre pocket opto 65 at the assembly's foot and the Center Pocket Flash (S28, two bulbs) above them. The retained script kicks a pocket's ball only while that pocket's switch is set. IPDB describes three scoops at the top of the centre feature that hold balls for multiball.
mechanisms.label: Center Pockets

mechanisms.behavior: Two gates at the top of the playfield, one at each end of the top-lane arch (S15 right, S16 left, CL00112 on the 20 V line). Each stands open while its coil is energized: the retained script sets RightGate.Open or LeftGate.Open while the coil is on and lets the gate's own timer close it after release, filtering PWM the ROM does not hold steady.
mechanisms.label: Top Gates

mechanisms.behavior: A captive ball lane on the upper left: a ball shot into the lane strikes a stationary Newton ball, which passes the hit to a captive ball above it; the captive ball rolls up over the captive rollover (79) to the captive standup (55) at the top. IPDB lists one captive ball and one Newton ball. The retained script creates the Newton ball in NBKicker and the captive ball in CBKicker and moves the captive ball when a playfield ball hits the Newton ball from below. No coil acts on it; lamps 3-5 and 8 (Captive Ball 1-3, EB) line the lane.
mechanisms.label: Captive Ball
